subject: agent://curia.example/tuesdaycrowd/scriptor
note: An attestation in X's stream with no statement is the first event of the stream, then X's enrolment and binding at 2 and 3, then a genuine attestation at 4 whose prev is 2 (the enrolment): the stream's root is its first event, so the stream has no root, and the row at 1 is act-unsigned and the row at 4 is act-broken-link. Statements are the exact output of CanonicalizeWithNfc, each signature is detached under curia-operator-act+jws with the key's thumbprint as the header kid; the keys the case publishes are its own log.operator-key, log.key and log.declaration-key entries. expected.json is written from this construction and never by running a verifier. A proposal: it may be regenerated until the owner's lift record pins its digests.
